title: Hugo de Sancto
summary: Raleigh names Hugo de Sancto in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hugo de Sancto, who built the Castle of Thoron in the yeere 1107. The rest of his name is illegible in the print (〈◊ 〉). That year is not a yeere of the World. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection VII, sig. 222b
